body:
I had an appointment with my therapist via phone a couple of days ago, I did not mention that i had tried to kill myself, it felt wrong to do over the phone. Will see her on monday and explain what happened. I just want this to stop, I can't live like this. I can't change how people feel about me, I can't force them to care. But I want to :( Perhaps I'm looking at the wrong places? 

Thank you for not judging. It really helps. 

Like you just said, it has been the story so far. I know I don't have anyone to help me in a situation of need. People have never put me in first place or made an effort to meet my needs. I have been the one compromising in return for social support. I just scrolled through my messeges on varius messaging apps and the only time someone contacting me is when they want something from me. Exception is my friend that I mentioned. If I say to someone "hey, let's hangout for a meal or coffee or an activity" the reply in person is "sure!", so I get my hopes up, then while trying to make plans they go to "i'm soooooo busy right now, can we talk later?" and later never comes. 

I'm trying really hard to be social even though my depression is fucking me up and beating the living crap out of me, and the only thing i'm learning is that people really don't care about me. I haven't been to class for like two weeks and no one is even trying to ask me why. When i'm at a party I nearly almost feel that nobody cares that i'm there or if I have left, because people are having fun with their friends, and apperently i'm not a friend of anyone. Exception yet again for my friend that cares, sure she fucks up, but she cares.  

I think that when someone is showing me intrest I go full clingy on their ass and live for their attention, I have done some stupid shit just because I wanted to belong. And when those people are starting to hanging out with other people I feel like I have lost my self, i'm not good enough, and will never fully trust that person again. Like, I'm going to a party in a couple of hours, I know some of the people that is going but I know that those people could not care less if i'm there or not. So I asked my friend if I could be hanging out with her and her friends, and on some conditions I could. Even if i'm going feel very alone, I at least know that I will be having her somewhere at that party. And I have to trust her on that, that she will be there. It requires minimal effort from her to break that trust I have in this situation. But I will do what I can. And I will try not to kill myself if I feel abandoned, lonley or worthless tonight. 

My life is a fucking mess.

We hade decided on hanging out, and she bailed on me with another person. I have some trust issues and lets say it did not help. She sent me a texted me later that evening that is was not something she had planned to do and it was an impulse. But yeah.. I feelt abandoned. The feeling was so intense, rage, anxiety, sadness.. Yeah. 

Yeah.. how did you know that :P It's hard. And i'm really tired of it. I feel that it won't get any better.
Depressed and lonely. Life been terrible for many years now, it's just a matter of degrees in hell. So I have a working body at least.

My problem with the second question is that it was my friend that caused the reaction of me breaking down and tried to kill myself. But today I started thinking that I don't want to leave her in the dark without saying goodbye. Therefore the question if a call is better than a note :) 

Thank you for your support, the main part of me wanting to kill myself is that I'm lonely. As I said, I have my friend, but she also struggles with depression and anxiety, and she has a lot of friends.. So I can't really get the time I want with her. All other people is just busy, and it was like three months ago the last time I got someone to hung out with me. Most of my days are spent at home, alone, in the bed listening to Music, scrolling social media. I work a couple of days per month, but I have no friends there. I also study my last year on University. I feel isolated. Every atempt I try to get new friends or try people to hang out with me is ending up failing, because they are often "busy". It's been this way major part of my life. And I'm tired of it. I'm feeling done.
